name: Gavel of Secular Damnation
body:
Price 50,305 gp; Aura faint conjuration, moderate evocation, strong abjuration; CL 7th; Weight 5 lbs.

DESCRIPTION

This +3 axiomatic merciful warhammer can be used to pound out a hasty sentence, knocking a foe miles deep into the ground to be confined in a personal prison of obscurity.

Once per day, when the wielder critically hits a foe, he can cause the foe to suffer imprisonment. If the target succeeds at a Will save against this effect (DC 23), the target is instead knocked several feet into the ground, effectively buried alive in a pit of dirt. Any creature buried alive in this way is trapped and can’t move and begins to suffocate.

Creatures outside of the pit can dig out the buried creature.

Each 5-foot cube of dirt weighs 3,000 pounds, and a creature can move 5 times her maximum load worth of dirt per minute, or 10 times her maximum load if she has a shovel or other appropriate tool.

Once all squares of dirt above a creature’s head have been removed, the creature can breathe, and can escape with a DC 15 Strength or Escape Artist check. A standing Medium creature typically has its head buried under 5 feet of earth (3,000 pounds). For a Small creature, this is increased to roughly 7 feet of earth (4,200 pounds). If the creature was prone when it was buried, its head is buried under the full 10 feet of earth (6,000 pounds).

CONSTRUCTION REQUIREMENTS

Cost 25,153 gp; Feats Craft Magic Arms and Armor; Spells cure light wounds, imprisonment, order’s wrath; Special creator must be lawful
